status: Corrected T05 candidate for visual review; T05 remains In Progress with an open T04 PBR stability regression
image_identity: request-context.json identifies the retained pre/post pair. No separate pre/post attachment identity is invented. Before is a fresh execution of the current original shader at c3468ed; the historical pair shown in chat was cf0b6bed.

root_causes.finding: Repeated albedo in direct diffuse light
root_causes.confidence: Confirmed by isolated pinned graphical test and pinned renderer source
root_causes.detail: The renderer applies albedo after custom diffuse accumulation. Gray source RGB8 51/127/204 became 4/60/163 under the old unity-band light; removing the extra factor restores 51/127/204. Ambient-only rows were unchanged.

root_causes.confidence: Confirmed inventory of 34 material surfaces (including the hidden comparison actor) and isolated comparisons
root_causes.detail: All 34 use linear mipmaps; 32 carry normal maps; 13 use UV offsets; four are double sided; all are opaque. Old conversion forced nearest sampling/double-sided/scissor, lost normal lighting, UV offsets, roughness and specular. One black source wood material needs reflection for its visible form.

root_causes.finding: Dark source reflection was still absent in the first correction
root_causes.confidence: Confirmed; caught during recursive review, corrected before final suite
root_causes.detail: The intermediate b646 diffuse-only candidate left connected black regions of 486/286/185/147/97 pixels that were visible in PBR. Source roughness/specular restoration removes that collapse in all five inspected regions. A nonzero-source black-material sky test and lost-reflection negative control guard it.

root_causes.confidence: Confirmed from raw depth/normal and masks; not every detailed source feature is an outline
root_causes.detail: Flat paving has no silhouette mask. Its repeated detail comes primarily from existing albedo/normal lighting. Roof and foliage include real geometric overlaps. Both surface planes now distinguish gaps from connected convex bends; shallower gaps blend with reduced contrast. Exterior cardinal-texel ownership is unchanged.

root_causes.finding: Highlight key-light vector differed from actual reference sun
root_causes.detail: The T05 hard-coded vector had the wrong world X orientation. A read-only T03 owner getter supplies the actual sun direction without changing the approved light or scene.

root_causes.finding: Stationary color changes follow the local-light path
root_causes.confidence: Confirmed localization; exact engine precision/culling cause remains a hypothesis
root_causes.detail: Unshaded, ambient-only, sun-only and fill-only were stable. Lantern-only varied up to 55 pixels/3 RGB8 levels. Disabling shadows or reapplying CPU state did not eliminate changes. Of tested 0/64/32/16 local attenuation steps, only 16 passed all six zoom/light stationary cases. No final RGB quantization or tolerance exception is applied.

changes.behavior: Single albedo factor; source color/UV/sampling/culling/alpha/normal lighting/roughness/specular preserved; original materials restored by toggle. Texture normals affect lighting while geometric normals remain available for edge selection.

Two-plane gap classification, contextual gap contrast, 0.75 outline/0.2 highlight strengths, actual sun direction; bands 0.25/0.65/1 at thresholds 0.2/0.65, transition 0.04; local attenuation rounded to 16 steps/unit.
Seven matched effect combinations, explicit same-state manifests, material diagnostic stage, large nearest previews and matching crops in offline reader.
34 graphical material checks, old-albedo/lost-reflection negative controls, incomplete isolation/state rejection tests and reproduction instructions.

visual_review.reviewer: Codex technical/visual inspection; project owner has not approved corrected appearance
visual_review.readability: At actual gameplay scale, corrected hair/skin, torso/arms, legs/boots and blue/purple clothing remain distinguishable. Warm barrel hoops and brown wood regain midtones; stair faces regain reflected form. Head/ears are a few pixels and facial detail is inherently limited. The corrected combined image is substantially easier to read than original T05; superiority over source PBR remains an owner decision.
visual_review.hierarchy: Outline contrast is reduced most at shallow gaps. Paving is no longer globally darkened by repeated albedo; its repeating source normal/texture pattern still competes with the small character. Leaf/roof intersections remain busy where actual geometry overlaps. These residual details are disclosed, not hidden by resolution changes or blur.
target_achievable: Stable pixel widths and separately reviewable lighting
visual_review.band_choice: Final-source hard [0.22,0.55,1], balanced [0.25,0.65,1] and lifted [0.4,0.8,1] captures cover both zooms and day/warm/cool plus swatches. Balanced is provisional: hard loses shadow separation; lifted flattens shade. It still needs owner approval.
visual_review.material_approximations: Direct specular lobes, metallic energy redistribution and transmission are intentionally omitted by the local toon material. Existing environment reflections preserve dark form; this does not implement T07 reflection features. The edge buffer and indirect lighting/reflections use geometric normals; texture normals affect custom direct diffuse lighting. This keeps texture microdetail out of geometric edge selection and is a disclosed difference from source PBR.
visual_review.pixel_policy: 384x216 plus existing 1px T04 guard, no AA selected, nearest presentation. 3840x2160 gameplay images are a GPU-rendered 10x nearest presentation. Native 4K toon material image uses 4x MSAA with outlines/highlights off and is supplemental detail only, never pixel/stability proof.
visual_review.motion_limit: 32 consecutive 30Hz samples per path; loop wrap restarts. One screen-space sample cannot reveal hidden geometry. No final packaging, other hardware or performance-budget acceptance is claimed.
